prompt: In a photorealistic photo, a sterile hospital corridor stretches into the distance. On the left wall, a fire extinguisher in a red case hangs next to a flickering fluorescent light panel. A nurse in blue scrubs stands near the center, holding a clipboard against her chest while looking at a patient chart. Beside her, an elderly man in a grey cardigan sits on a plastic chair, clutching a cane with both hands. To the right, a young woman in a yellow dress leans against the wall, checking her smartphone screen. A small brown dog on a leash stands next to her, looking up expectantly. Further down the hall on the left, a doctor in a white coat points at an X-ray film held by a technician in green attire. The technician nods while adjusting his glasses. In the center foreground, a metal gurney with wheels is parked, occupied by a sleeping child wrapped in a blue blanket. A worried mother in a pink sweater sits on the edge of the gurney, holding the child's hand tightly. Behind them, a janitor in a grey uniform pushes a cleaning cart filled with bottles and mops. He looks toward the nurse in blue scrubs. Near the ceiling on the right, a security camera lens glints under the artificial light. A potted fern in a white ceramic pot sits on a side table next to the waiting area. A magazine lies open on the floor beside the pot. A vending machine with glass doors stands at the far end of the corridor on the right, displaying rows of soda cans. A teenager in a hoodie kicks the base of the vending machine lightly. An older lady in a floral blouse walks past him, carrying a tote bag. She glances at the teenager briefly. A pair of crutches leans against the wall near the fire extinguisher. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. There is no sunlight streaming through windows. There is no text readable on any signs or objects.
